comment: Hydra — two extra playback heads on one delay ring. The dry goes into the ring; a 2x head and a 0.5x head are re-triggered every Window from one window behind the write head. The 2x head closes the gap at 1 sample/sample, so it consumes TWO windows of history per window and lands flush on the write head (double-time ghost, octave up); the 0.5x head falls behind, covering half a window per window with a max lag of 1.5 windows (half-time drag, octave down). Window is what makes this one effect rather than two: at a few ms the re-trigger rate IS the pitch, so you get time-aligned octave-up/octave-down layers; at 100 ms..1 s the re-trigger lands at rhythmic rates and the layers become double-time hits and a half-time drag. Aimed at drums.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack; the mechanism is genuinely a multi-tap delay.
fxid_comment: 0x01CB. Free: no stock effect uses it and it is not a retired custom alias (checked against tools/effects_db.json). Sits with the 450-458 custom block.

params.name: Window
params.comment: Re-trigger length, exponential ~3 ms .. 1 s. Low = granular octave-up/down layers in time with the dry; high = rhythmic double-time / half-time ghosts.

params.name: Fast
params.comment: Level of the 2x head (octave up / double time). Independent so either head can be used alone.

params.name: Slow
params.comment: Level of the 0.5x head (octave down / half time).

params.name: Tone
params.comment: Low-pass on the two layers ONLY, so they tuck under the dry. The 2x head gets spiky on cymbals.
